text:
Amara Chen: quick sync thread — i'm drafting the PRD for kernel fallback behavior and launch gating. primary goal: safe automatic fallback when preferred attention/kernel hits errors or capacity limits. Need acceptance criteria and edge cases from runtime, pm, and sres. https://rbw.internal/notes/kernel-fallback-draft :wave:

Sanjay Iyer: thanks — will read. can you call out the critical SLOs you want enforced on fallback? p99, error-rate, and correctness delta?

Amara Chen: yes. initial asks: p50/p90/p99 latency targets per model family (listed in draft), error-rate < 0.5% after fallback, and semantic regression threshold: BLEU/EM/embedding-similarity drop <= 2% for customer prompt-sets. also require canary window metrics + auto-rollback.

Lia Park: from PM POV add business gating: any fallback that increases cost >10% for customer tier "standard" must be opt-in. customers on enterprise tier can opt into aggressive fallback. include migration notes for Dedicated.

Oz Martinez: SRE constraints: fallbacks must not open up unbounded resource usage. we need throttles and circuit-breakers: config knobs for max concurrent fallback threads and per-host eviction quotas. also audit logs for every fallback decision.

Jen Castillo: runtime note — some quantized kernels change tokenization ties (rare). we should add an "output-stability" check for 1k recent requests sampling to avoid noisy regressions. If sampling shows >2% drift we fail the rollout.

Thomas Nguyen: for research/eval: i'll prepare a small prompt-set (200 prompts across doc summarization, dialog, code) to compute embedding-sim and ROUGE deltas. do we want per-model thresholds or global?

Amara Chen: per-model family preferred (llama-like vs mixtral vs code models). i'll add a table to the doc.

Sanjay Iyer: a couple of edge cases to call out:
- kv cache miss on fallback: if we switch kernels mid-conversation, we lose KV state unless we transfer/serialize. need acceptance: either transparent transfer (preferred) or a documented reset with explicit token prefixing and short warning to caller.
- long context windows: some kernels are optimized for short seq; fallback may spike latency for long-seq requests. define max sequence length per kernel and auto-decline fallback for requests > X tokens.
- mixed-mode routing: when partial fallback (only cross-attn vs self-attn kernels) occurs, ensure correctness tests run.

Amara Chen: good. add those to requirements. Also, specify rollout plan: dev canary (5% traffic, 1 model family), infra canary (single region), then staged ramp (5-25-50) with 24h stability windows and an automated rollback on p99 degrade > 10% or error-rate increase > 0.3%.

Lia Park: acceptance checklist suggestion (short):
- PRD: requirements + per-model thresholds
- Tests: unit + integration + end-to-end with sample prompts
- Canary plan: regions, %s, monitoring dashboards
- Cost impact: simulation for 30d
- Docs: behavior, config knobs, KMS notes if Private

Sanjay Iyer: quick config snippet for circuit-breaker idea:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  max_concurrent: 50 # per host
  error_rate_threshold: 0.005
  cost_increase_threshold: 0.10
  allow_partial_kernel_switch: false
```

Oz Martinez: rollbacks should be a single toggle in control plane and also allow per-customer override. make sure control-plane change triggers an audit log event and alert to oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy status: kernel-fallback-draft.md updated at 2069991160 by amara. CI: tests running (12/34).

Jen Castillo: edge-case: models with external plugins/tools. If fallback changes response timing, tool-calling timeouts might trigger. add a test scenario where tool call latency budgets are enforced.

Thomas Nguyen: also call out non-determinism in sampling evals — we should seed RNG for eval runs and store seeds in artifact to reproduce.

Amara Chen: action items:
- (Sanjay) add explicit KV transfer options and implement prefetched-serialization prototype by EOD Fri
- (Jen) create stability sampler + tool-call timeout tests, PR by Wed
- (Thomas) produce canonical prompt-set + seeds by Thu
- (Lia) add customer-tier cost gating to PRD and update Dedicated notes by Tue
- (Oz) design circuit-breaker alerting and audit log schema by next sprint

Lia Park: acked. Can we have a short review meeting Thurs 11am to approve acceptance criteria?

Amara Chen: yes please. I'll post doc link + agenda before EOD Wed. :calendar:

Sanjay Iyer: i'll bring initial prototype and perf numbers to the meeting.

Oz Martinez: i'll bring failure-mode runbook drafts.

Amara Chen: thanks everyone. keeping this thread short — please reply if you want a different meeting time or to be added to participants. :thumbsup:
